link.label: Send your security questions. We answer in writing.

items.a: We design, build, host and maintain custom software for businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and manual processes: operational portals, internal tools, automation and data integrations, on whichever technology fits the problem.

items.q: How does Wezigns approach software security?
items.a: We build security into access design, data handling, system connections and testing from the first version. No software stays secure without upkeep, so we keep reviewing and maintaining it after launch.

items.q: Can Wezigns take over software built by another company?
items.a: Yes. We take over systems other teams built, whatever they chose to build on, and folding that into ongoing hosting, support and maintenance is a normal part of the work.

items.q: Does Wezigns work with small businesses?
items.a: Yes, where custom software is genuinely the right answer. Sometimes it is not, and we will say so.

items.q: How much does custom software development cost?
items.a: It depends on scope, integrations and how much of the process has to change, not on the technology involved. Price and timeline come out of the Shape stage, before anything is built.
Also a Shape-stage answer. Work is delivered in working pieces rather than one long build, so there is something to test and review early.

fields.label: What is happening today?
fields.placeholder: Our current scheduling process relies on two manual sheets. As our volume has scaled, entries are getting missed and our team is spending hours correcting bookings…

promise.strong: A senior person from our team replies within one working day.
promise.rest: They can talk through your process and what a system for it would involve.

sections.note: No generic pitch deck. No pressure. Price and timeline are agreed before anything is built.

cases.title: One system instead of spreadsheets and chat threads
body: A nationwide safety training operation ran on spreadsheets and messaging threads. We replaced them with one system: registration, trainer scheduling and compliance reporting, together.
Administrative work fell by 80%. The system now handles more than 100,000 certifications a year, with proctored audits built in.

cases.title: One record of events, instead of email threads
body: Operators, event planners and government agencies were coordinating a national tourism calendar over email and spreadsheets. We built the platform that gives them a single shared record of events and listings.
It has run with zero unplanned downtime, handling up to 40,000 requests a minute at peak. Data stays in-country.

cases.title: One dashboard for hundreds of people running one event
body: A large annual engineering event needed one place to see what hundreds of people were doing in real time. We built the operations dashboard and participant platform that gives them that.
It runs on AWS for high availability, with low-latency monitoring and encrypted backups.

cases.title: Sellers grew fifteen times over. Support headcount did not
body: A regional B2B marketplace was checking every seller catalogue by hand. We built automated onboarding with real-time API integrations.
Active sellers grew from 300 to 4,500, with the same core support team.
